details.summary: Behind your certificate: how did Odoo make this PDF?

ol.li: A report is a record of ir.actions.report: its name, the model it prints (here academy.progress), the type qweb-pdf, and a paper format, landscape A4. See the record (Settings > Technical > Reports)
The button Download your certificate calls the method report_action() of that record, for your progress.

The report renders a QWeb template: HTML with t-out, t-foreach, t-att-src... filled with your name and your app. wkhtmltopdf turns that HTML into the PDF. See the template (Settings > Technical > Views, developer mode)

details.div: Every PDF of Odoo, invoices and quotations included, is made this way.

t.details: How do I add my own folder? Odoo reads its addons folders when it starts. Add yours to addons_path in odoo.conf (or to --addons-path), put your module folder in it, and restart Odoo: it then shows in this list. Odoo skips a folder that holds no module yet. Its own folder for your modules, ~/.local/share/Odoo/addons/<version>, is always there when it can be written to.
t.div: Odoo has no addons folder of your own it can write to. Create the folder yourself in the addons folder of your other modules, and write the files there. Odoo ignores an addons folder that holds no module yet.
